content.content: the artifact of zswmtqst is necessary to svssunnl or tmmynypo and faithful to them in both directions: it enforces exactly what they state, no stricter and no looser, and smuggles in nothing they do not — fail on any rule that diverges in either direction, naming it
content.rationale: prose prerequisites with a tool-checkable artifact dependent: prose says what counts as conforming and the artifact enforces it, so the gate pins the two together in both directions
